decisions.reason: The firm has invested in building on its established offer and maintains a dedicated website page, so dropping it would write off that investment and expose the launch as a mistake.
Although its website presentation was reduced to a mention, the product is close to the established offer and still publicly visible, so management likely persists to justify the earlier commitment.
The product builds on established capabilities and remains mentioned on the website, so the firm has enough sunk costs and public commitment to continue rather than drop it.
